newsitem.title: GERMANY: Japan will cooperate with G7 if yen falls further.
newsitem.headline: Japan will cooperate with G7 if yen falls further.

text.p: Japan will cooperate with other Group of Seven (G7) nations if the yen depreciates further, Eisuke Sakakibara, director gneral of the Japanese ministry of finance's International Finance Bureau, said on Saturday.
Asked about the possibility the Bank of Japan would intervene in the currency market if the yen slid further in the post-G7 foreign exchange market, Sakaibara said "We will cooperate."
Japan, the United States and Europe have not been in discord over the foreign exchange market movements, he said.
The United States, Germany, Japan, France, Italy, Canada and Britain are members of the G7. Sakakibara is seen by the currency markets as one of the most influential Japanese officials.
